ai.title: Wall Street ticks higher as AI stocks recover more losses and oil prices ease
ai.description: The U.S. stock market is ticking higher as artificial-intelligence stocks regain more of their sudden and sharp losses from last week, while oil prices ease. The S&P 500 rose 0.2% Tuesday and pulled back within 2.5% of its all-time high set a week ago. The Dow Jones Industrial Average added 195 points, and the Nasdaq composite was close to flat. J.M. Smucker jumped to the biggest gain in the S&P 500 after becoming the latest U.S. company to report better profit for the latest quarter than analysts expected. Airline stocks flew higher as the price for a barrel of Brent crude dropped more than 3%.
